'''''Star Wars: TIE Fighter''''' is a [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Jody Houser]] and illustrated by [[Rogê Antônio]]. The series,<ref name="TIE Fighter" /> which takes place in the days leading up to the [[Battle of Endor]]<ref name="TIE Fighter 5">[[TIE Fighter 5|''TIE Fighter'' 5]]</ref> in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> focuses on [[204th Imperial Fighter Wing|Shadow Wing]], a group of elite [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilots]]. The first issue of ''TIE Fighter'' was published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[April]] 17, [[2019]].<ref name="TIE Fighter" />
